title: MURDLE — Murder at the White-Collar Prison
subtitle: 6 suspects, 6 weapons, 6 locations
storyHtml:
Deductive Logico arrived at a luxurious white-collar prison, where Inspector Irratino had been murdered.

Each suspect brought one weapon to one location, but only one was the murderer.

Logico examined the clues one at a time, marking each discovery on the Deduction Grid.

clues.text: Agent Fuchsia had a Poisoned Cake.
The second-tallest suspect had not been in the Spa.
Lady Violet had a weapon made of alcohol.
Murdle Volume 2 was found beside a video game console in the Rec Room.
A single cufflink was found at the Guard Tower, a great place for a photograph.
Sister Lapis thought she was in love with the person who brought the Gold Watch.
A paper detector gave a positive reading on Viscount Eminence.
Frosting was found beside a king-sized bed in the Private Suite.
The Golden Handcuffs were clearly used to commit the murder.
